games.name: Loot Hero [Beta]
games.desc:
A fast-paced roguelite game where you get different upgrades every run, and can unlock items to equip for all future runs. Supports co-op with up to 2 players.

PC Controls:
    WASD or Arrow Keys - Move
    Spacebar - Dash

Xbox Controls:
    A - Select
    B, LT, or RT - Dash
    Back - Lock/Unlock Cursor
    R3 - Change Zoom Level

Opening the Roblox menu will pause the game.
